summary: Senior technology leader with 27+ years of IT infrastructure experience across Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI), Desktop in Data Center (DiDC), End User Computing (EUC), lifecycle management, performance engineering, and global escalation leadership across major financial institutions: Morgan Stanley, Bank of America, AIA, Edge Technology Group, and Merrill Lynch. Former VP & Asia Manager for Workspace Virtualization Engineering at Morgan Stanley, serving as the primary APAC escalation lead for VDI issues across APAC, EMEA, and NA. Architected global VDI blueprints supporting 120,000 desktops and authored 8 global white papers. Hands-on innovator with proven ability to build AI-powered automation tools, dashboards, and agentic systems.

linkedin_recommendations.recommendation: John is a fantastic person to have on the team in the fact that he's strong technical lead who has the unique ability to be an excellent problem solver, great at technical documentation and is always willing to learn from others and take one challenges. With this in mind, John has always taken the time to consider the needs of the business/clients during the programs I have worked with him on. I worked with John when leading a global program for business revenue generation, where John was the Stream Lead of Application Remediation (Citrix XenApp External trading Plant). Some of the program challenges were that the application itself had little documentation and written processes, and roles and responsibilities across different global teams were either undocumented or unclear. John took on the huge and complex challenge to reverse engineer the trading application that involved substantial integration with others systems including our low latency plant. In turn John designed the overall architecture for the solution working diligently with various teams to uncover the document the processes, trained the necessary teams and came up with a foundation of Roles and Responsibilities model to improve the overall support processes. John is well suited in leading complex enterprise technology solutions and I would highly recommend John to any team for a for a leadership role as he has extensive experiences both from both a technical and soft skills perspective.

linkedin_recommendations.recommendation: I worked with John from Aug 2017 to present-day on a global roll-out strategy for a vital Citrix component. The project involved technical experts and developers in all three major time-zones (NA, EU and Asia) and involved a great deal of coordination. John was an invaluable resource to coordinate the various groups to work towards the wider goal of rolling out the product into production. One of the ways this collaboration was successful was John's ability to facilitate and coordinate the various groups.

John is team driven and technical in nature. Wanting to do what's right for the firm and collaborating with teams from multidisciplinary fields to work together to come up with solutions to improve stability and efficiency. In addition, John wrote multiple white papers to conclude technical analysis whether certain designs were capable to handle loads from a scalable perspective.

John is the Citrix Storefront Lead responsible to deliver to remote access myDesk global web portal used by Firmwide employees. John has been instrumental in applying Agile Scrum and DevOps model throughout the delivery of the SDLC of product. Besides, John being technically strong, he has excellent communication skills and ensure that the product requirements are well understood amongst the key stakeholders so that technically dev, engineering, operations, product management, quality assurance and project management teams are all on the same page. John would run the extra mileage to raise risks and escalate issues to senior management to ensure timely mitigation.

John was an experienced, valuable contributor and a skilled engineer in our team prior to me joining it. After a well deserved promotion he became the engineering lead in a critical infrastructure project where I was a contributing engineer. He was great at taking ownership of a project and running with it, while carefully managing the various stakeholders' requirements, and all the communication and politics that it entails. I would recommend John for an employer who is looking for an accomplished engineer and leader who can take on complex technical projects and see them through their execution.
